Gemma 4 is Google's open multimodal AI model family (text/image/audio/video) with quantization-aware training variants for efficient deployment.
Google DeepMind's multimodal AI model supporting text, images, audio, and video with reasoning and up to 256K context.

Gemma 4 is a family of multimodal AI models (text, image, audio) from Google DeepMind with quantization-aware training for memory efficiency, supporting up to 256K context and available in sizes from 2B to 31B parameters.
Google's Gemma 4 edge-optimized instruction-tuned model, designed for efficient on-device inference.
Fine-tuned Gemma 4 12B for Python coding with chain-of-thought reasoning, runs locally in 4.5–12GB GGUF quants on consumer hardware.
OpenAI's gpt-oss-20b is an open-weight 21B-parameter (3.6B active) language model with native MXFP4 quantization, designed for reasoning, agentic tasks, and fine-tuning under the Apache 2.0 license.
Google's Gemma 4 dense instruction-tuned model, designed for general-purpose text generation and understanding.

An open-weight MoE vision-language model for agentic coding with 35B total/3B active parameters and 262K context.
Google DeepMind's Gemma 4 12B is an encoder-free multimodal model (text, image, audio, video) with a 256K context window.

Qwen-AgentWorld-35B-A3B is a native language world model (35B parameters, 3B activated) trained via CPT, SFT, and RL to simulate seven agent interaction domains (MCP, Search, Terminal, SWE, Android, Web, OS) by predicting next environment states from agent actions.
